markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (100%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Single-class conformal set and full neighbor agreement support this [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive >99%, InSitu <1% | Strongly favors invasive |
| Conformal set | {Invasive}, α=0.1 | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.999 / 1.0 percentile | No reliability flag |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Yes | Same top class |
| Similar cases | 5 of 5 Invasive | Neighbors fully agree |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 0, 4, 6) · ↑ invasive · Score above typical; spot check 19/20 [F3] · Validated
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 2, 9, 11) · ↑ invasive · Score above typical; spot check 18/20 [F4] · Validated
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 1, 2, 7) · ↑ invasive · Highest concept term, but spot check 0/20 [F2] · Unreliable
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 2, 6, 8) · ↑ invasive · Score high; spot check 3/20 · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60). It is faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Concept deletion effect is 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007), which includes 0. It is not shown to reflect the classifier. This case leans on Unreliable mitoses and necrosis.

## Could be wrong if
- Input is JPEG-degraded (severity 3); the reliability score ranks errors only modestly (AUROC 0.69, CI 0.58–0.87).
- Calibration was checked on only 132 test images; ECE 0.05, CI 0.03–0.18.

## Check on the slide
1. **0, 4, 6**: confirm stromal invasion; region 0 touches the tumor-at-margin edges [F7].
2. **2, 9, 11**: confirm marked nuclear pleomorphism.
3. **1, 2, 6, 7, 8**: judge mitoses and necrosis yourself; their model scores failed spot checks.
